about_the_game:
This "Tokyo Xtreme Racer Guest Rival Vol. 1" is additional content for "Tokyo Xtreme Racer".

▼Content Details

"hololive DEV_IS Affiliated　FLOW GLOW　Rindo Chihaya"

- Addition of guest rival character

- Addition of exclusive custom car

Appears at Heiwajima Parking Area (Down) after Stage 2

"Tokyo Xtreme Racer Guest Rival Vol. 1" will be available for a limited time from (JST)[October 23, 2025] to [September 30, 2026].

If purchased within this period, you can continue to use it even after sales end.

There is a possibility of period extension or re-release depending on circumstances.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-7700 or Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen™ 5 1600X or AMD Ryzen™ 7 1700
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1050 Ti(VRAM 4GB) or AMD Radeon™ RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 1920x1080 with graphics setting at “Low” recommended. SSD recommended.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-Bit
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i7-13700 or AMD Ryzen™ 9 7900X or AMD Ryzen™ 7 7700X
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® RTX 3060(VRAM 8GB) or AMD Radeon™ RX 6700
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 12 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: graphics setting at “High” recommended. SSD recommended.
